description: This file defines a class `SugarWidgetSubPanelRemoveButtonAccount` that extends `SugarWidgetSubPanelRemoveButton`. It provides a method `displayList` which conditionally calls the parent method based on the `EditView` property of the layout definition, used for rendering a remove button in a SugarCRM subpanel for accounts.

classes.name: SugarWidgetSubPanelRemoveButtonAccount
classes.description: A subclass of SugarWidgetSubPanelRemoveButton tailored for account subpanels, controlling the display of remove buttons based on the layout definition.

methods.name: displayList
methods.description: Overrides the parent method to check if the 'EditView' property of layout_def is true; if not, it returns false, otherwise calls the parent displayList method.
